mapper.sql: SELECT art.id, art.id_site, art.status, art.pause_reason, art.notes, art.cadence, art.start_date, art.end_date, art.keep_cycle, art.recipient_to, art.recipient_cc, DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(art.modified_date, 'UTC', t.value), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS modified_date, art.modified_by, CONCAT_WS(' ', e.first_name, e.last_name) AS modified_by_name
FROM analytical_report_tracker art JOIN site s ON s.id = art.id_site JOIN time_zone t ON t.id = s.id_time_zone LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = art.modified_by
